method: Read all 435 complete native source units first, in four consecutive exact-order batches from the frozen seed, before reviewing target claims.
Independently read each complete source, actual target passage, relationship and rationale in four progressive authored batches; read the additional painted-idol pair separately.

Read all named necessary surrounding context, including complete Wisdom as source context, all author-listed context and additional peer-selected context. Native gaps and continuations were preserved.

Required precise corrections to native wording, narrator identity, plural antecedents, target scope and the fire/harp explanations. Reread all 19 new or amended complete triples, including four spacing-only amendments and the added pair.
Read all 31 complete deferred source units and their specific reasons. No targetless source or unread hint received completion credit.
Compared final row content against independently read snapshots and bound acceptance to the frozen final author, TSV and cases hashes.
